title: O'Deadly Skyrim
tagline: Randomized OStim events for the whole world, not just the player — as light or as dark as you want.
description:
O'Deadly Skyrim

A SkyrimNet environmental mod. It adds randomized OStim events to Skyrim for you, your followers, and the people already around you, not just the player.

Life is random. Some moments are good, some are funny, and some are dark. Every chance is toggleable and adjustable, so you can keep things light or push it into darker territory. Install it and leave it alone until something actually happens.

This was based on the idea of ODangerous Nights. I never downloaded ODangerous Nights, so I have no idea if it is compatible. ODangerous Nights is not needed — this does the same thing, and so much more.

**Adults only.** Children are never involved, in any role. That is not a setting.

## Family-safe switch

The master switch in the MCM is **off by default**. Nothing in this mod runs until you turn it on. Bind the Panic key under it (unbound by default). One press stops any scene this mod started, removes anyone it spawned, turns the mod off, and stops SkyrimNet from talking about it. Use it if you need the game family-safe in a hurry.

## Requirements: (Mod Integration not selected as integrated mods are optional)

- Skyrim SE or AE (1.6.x), including GOG. Not Oldrim or Skyrim VR (May work with VR but never tested).
- SKSE64 (the build that matches your game)
- OStim Standalone 7.5.x (API 7.1+)
- SkyUI
- powerofthree's Papyrus Extender (the build that matches your game)

The plugin is an ESL that masters only Skyrim.esm. There is no SKSE .dll of ours. Place it near the end of your load order. Nolvus users: do not place this plugin below Paper Maps.

## Optional, auto-detected

None of these are required, and none of them is a master:

- **SkyrimNet**: narration, memories, rumours, and a "would this character do it?" check against their bio. The decision prompt ships in the download and turns on when SkyrimNet is present. Without SkyrimNet the engine still runs, using its own character filter.
- **OCreatures**: unlocks the Creatures page
- **OCum**, **ZaZ Animation Pack**, **OStimNet**
- **iActions**: better drink detection and morning-after partner preference
- **Dirt and Blood** or **Bathing in Skyrim**: the bathing module
- **Blood and OStim** and **Sacrosanct**: Dark Gift feeding and vampirism
- **OStim Kidnapped Redux** (Lirael): SkyrimNet hears when you are taken, slip an ambush, escape, are let go, or are sold. O'Deadly holds its own encounters while you are held.
- **ODefeat Reforged** (Lirael): SkyrimNet hears when you are defeated and what happens next. A downed player is left to ODefeat Reforged; O'Deadly's Defeat module still handles followers.
- **The Killer Rabbit of Caerbannog** (Mihail): unlocks a third Climax fauna option that can spawn his killer rabbits after a climax. The unique rabbit in the Cave of Caerbannog is left alone. None of his files are included.

## What you can turn on

Night attacks, jails and barracks, inns, defeat, trespass, roads, relationships, optional creatures, plus morning after, bathing, shared inn rooms, watched from a distance, Dark Gift, mid-battle follower rescue, and a silly climax easter egg (vanilla rabbits and butterflies, or Mihail's Killer Rabbits of Caerbannog if that mod is installed). Every module is off by default and sits behind the master switch.

Download the latest release from the External URL. Full notes, source, and the changelog are in that GitHub repository.

By That Guy (Coronerra).

changelog:
O'Deadly Skyrim 0.7 (A SkyrimNet environmental mod) by That Guy (Coronerra).

Fixed: crash on save with NPC AI Position Fix after a sleep event. NPC AI Position Fix keeps track of every NPC that is moved or loaded in while you sleep or wait, then repositions them when the rest ends. 0.6 woke you and spawned its sleep-event characters while the sleep was still running, so they ended up on that mod's list and were removed later. That could crash the game on the next save.

Sleep events now begin as you wake. The roll still happens when you lie down, with the same chances as before. Nothing is moved, spawned or started until the sleep has finished and the Sleep/Wait menu has closed, plus a one-second pause so other mods can finish their own after-rest work. The sleep itself is no longer interrupted.
The morning after now also waits for the menu to close. Wait events pause one second after the menu closes.
If something else cuts your sleep short (another mod's event, an attack), the event rolled for that sleep is dropped. Loading a save, the panic key or turning the master switch off clears any sleep event that has not started yet.
Fixed: a Bathing scene could start before a long bath had finished. With the Malignis Animations - BiSR DnB Patch a bath runs about 65 seconds, and 0.6 gave up waiting after 60. O'Deadly now waits until the actor has really left the bath (up to 150 seconds), pauses 2.5 seconds so clothes and controls are restored, then stages. Someone still in a running bath is never picked as the partner.

Same plugin, records and FormIDs; still only Skyrim.esm as master. Same settings and defaults; master switch still OFF; kill switch, panic key and adults-only rules unchanged. SkyrimNet pack version 0.7.0.
Install: download ODeadly_Skyrim_0.7.zip, install in MO2 and overwrite 0.6; settings carry over. Best updated while not asleep or waiting. See the README and changelog.
